subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` attempt reattach/wait/replay before its existing automatic fresh-session fallback after an accepted Gateway run disconnects?
rationale: The branch now preserves the prior rerun default, but still changes when users receive a response and when a second execution is attempted; the linked design issue explicitly requests an owner decision on that user-facing tradeoff.

options.title: Adopt reattach-first with current fallback
options.body: Recover the authoritative Gateway result first and retain the present automatic isolated fallback only when recovery cannot establish the outcome.

options.title: Keep direct fallback
options.body: Retain the current immediate fresh-session fallback and decline the added wait/replay behavior for ambiguous disconnects.

recommendation.title: Adopt reattach-first with current fallback
recommendation.body: Recover the authoritative Gateway result first and retain the present automatic isolated fallback only when recovery cannot establish the outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged fresh-session fallback behavior is the direct compatibility baseline for this decision.
